constraints.name: auth_mfa_budget_subject_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (subject_id) REFERENCES auth_subjects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: auth_mfa_enrollments_session_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES auth_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: auth_mfa_enrollments_subject_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (subject_id) REFERENCES auth_mfa_factors(subject_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: auth_mfa_factors_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((enabled AND (key_id <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(secret) >= 28)) OR ((NOT enabled) AND (key_id = ''::text) AND (octet_length(secret) = 0))))

constraints.name: auth_mfa_factors_subject_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (subject_id) REFERENCES auth_subjects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: auth_mfa_pending_setup_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((setup_id = ''::text) AND (setup_key_id = ''::text) AND (octet_length(setup_secret) = 0) AND (octet_length(setup_recovery) = 0)) OR ((kind = 'enrollment'::text) AND (length(setup_id) = 43) AND ((length(setup_key_id) >= 1) AND (length(setup_key_id) <= 64)) AND (octet_length(setup_secret) >= 28) AND (octet_length(setup_recovery) = 320))))

constraints.name: auth_mfa_pending_subject_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (subject_id) REFERENCES auth_mfa_factors(subject_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: auth_mfa_recovery_subject_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (subject_id) REFERENCES auth_mfa_factors(subject_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: auth_mfa_budget_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_mfa_budget_pkey ON public.auth_mfa_budget USING btree (subject_id)

indexes.name: auth_mfa_enrollments_expiry_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX auth_mfa_enrollments_expiry_idx ON public.auth_mfa_enrollments USING btree (expires_at)

indexes.name: auth_mfa_enrollments_pkey

indexes.name: auth_mfa_factors_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_mfa_factors_pkey ON public.auth_mfa_factors USING btree (subject_id)

indexes.name: auth_mfa_pending_expiry_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX auth_mfa_pending_expiry_idx ON public.auth_mfa_pending USING btree (expires_at)

indexes.name: auth_mfa_pending_pkey
